newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BBV sells 2.76 pct of Iberdrola.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BBV sells 2.76 pct of Iberdrola.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya said on Tuesday it had sold 2.76 percent of electricity firm Iberdrola at a price of 1,815 pesetas per share to institutional investors.

"Compania de Cartera e Inversiones and Corporacion Industrial y Services, both owned by BBV, have sold 25.2 million shares in Iberdrola during today's bourse session to institutional investors at a price of 1,815 pesetas per share," BBV said in a statement.
The sale brings BBV's shareholding in line with its aim to reduce its stake in the electricity firm to 7.51 percent from 10.31 percent.

"Through this operation, BBV decreases its concentration on the electricity sector and balances it with respect to its presence in other sectors (telecommunications, petrol, distribution etc.)," BBV said.

BBV said it had held a 10.31 percent stake in Iberdrola due to regulatory requirements on consolidation of holdings. Now that this regulation has been modified to five percent, BBV said it did not need to hold such a high shareholding.
Despite reducing its stake, BBV said it considered itself a permanent member among Iberdrola's key shareholders.
